perks.name: Shoot to Loot
perks.desc: Shooting an Orb of Power picks it up. Shooting an ammo brick picks it up and automatically reloads all of your equipped weapons from reserves.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Overflow
perks.desc: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo automatically loads this weapon beyond normal capacity.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Subsistence
perks.desc: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Encore
perks.desc: Final blows grant a stacking stability, range, and accuracy bonus to this weapon. Precision final blows grant more stacks.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.desc: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

perks.name: All-Star
perks.desc:
Collecting ammo loads this weapon from reserves and enhances its damage and reload speed for a duration.

Collecting Heavy ammo grants more time.

perks.name: Adhesive Ordnance
perks.desc: Collecting ammo loads an explosive round that adheres to surfaces, detonates shortly after impact, and applies exhaust.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

perks.name: Headseeker
perks.desc: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Multikill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

perks.name: Osmosis
perks.desc: Using your grenade ability partially refills the magazine and changes this weapon's damage type to match your grenade until you stow it.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Veteran's Wisdom
perks.desc: Rapid or precision final blows release a Kinetic shockwave that exhausts targets.

perks.name: Field-Tested
perks.desc:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

notes: Inspired by @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard and Very Hard difficulty. The reprised Battle Scar is a Lightweight pulse rifle which as a subfamily are currently rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis spreadsheet in https://www.destiny2.science/ as "essentially just a worse high-impact auto". The frame intrinsic offers built-in anti-Overload, and +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with its peers - you can see the stats at https://destiny.report/w/1525080480/battle-scar and hopefully https://d2foundry.gg/w/1525080480 will show how weapon stats impact in-game performance when the site is back up and running. The recoil is vertical but loose, so to tighten that up, look for a barrel perk that helps with Recoil Direction or, if you can handle it just go for extra handling, and then with the magazine perk go for something that helps improve magazine size or reload. For clearing groups of adds, in the second trait perk column Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE Kinetic shockwaves after 11 hits (10 when enhanced) within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage so inherit damage boosts. You can pair either Shoot to Loot, which lets you pick up remote ammo bricks or orbs from safety by shooting them, which also reloads all your weapons from reserves or Attrition Orbs spawns a power orb after ~28 hits within 5s of each other to proc armour mods - both have their range of effect extended by the kinetic shockwaves. The Veteran's Wisdom origin trait procs on a crit kill or 3 kills within 3s of each other to generate an 8m (9m when enhanced) AoE kinetic shockwave which inflicts Exhaust on enemies, or there's Field-Tested which starts subtly but if you can stay alive to get kills, you'll start to feel the gunfeel stat boosts as you get to the higher stacks. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 56 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/6hjWp0NaachsNymnN22FDL) with @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects. First-choice PvE roll for Minor add-clear in end-game content. Not a lot of current competition for lightweight pulse rifles (as at v7.0.0.7, anyway) but they add a very useful +20 mobility (useful when buildcrafting) and +6.25% movement speed. Unfortunately, the stats on the reprised Battle Scar are low across the board - the New Devrim Kay VIII Foundry Field Tested origin perk should help, but it takes a long time to proc the higher tiers (five stacks would take 1001 hits to achieve!). You'd really be looking for Arrowhead Brake in the barrel ideally, to help clean up the low recoil direction and, if you prefer stability and reload speed go for Tactical Mag, or for range go for Accurized Rounds. Battle Scar is one of the first kinetic weapons that can roll with Kinetic Tremors as your signature perk in the second trait column - for end-game activities this pairs nicely with Shoot to Loot as, as well as the passive damage boost just for repeated hits you will also pick up ammo from anywhere in the shockwave area and reload all of your guns too. Recommended MW: TBH anything will work - just go with your preference, with a damage-boosting (Minor, Taken Spec) mod
